title: Establish enterprise compatibility matrix + regulatory intake lane for model catalog
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers request model variants (new open models, quantized builds, and vendor forks) but our current catalog intake lacks a deterministic, auditable way to assess operational compatibility and regulatory constraints. That leads to ad-hoc pin requests, repeated legal triage, and surprise regressions when models are promoted to production.

Proposal: Build an enterprise-focused admission lane coupled with an automated compatibility matrix and an explicit 'regulatory' triage path. The intake will collect structured metadata (license, training data provenance, tokenizer family, architecture family, quantization format, expected p99 latency, regional restrictions, required SLOs, and compliance tags). The compatibility matrix will run automated checks and a lightweight eval battery to produce a risk + effort score used to route to one of three lanes: self-serve, engineering-assisted, or legal/regulatory review.

Key components to deliver in this ticket: 1) Intake form schema for enterprise requests; 2) Compatibility auto-checker (tokenizer mismatch, unsupported ops, quantization incompatibility warnings); 3) Eval gate templates (latency-correctness smoke suite, hallucination heuristics); 4) Regulatory lane workflow and mandatory fields for data residency/KMS/audit requirements; 5) Safe-pin policy template (default safe-pin window, rollback plan, shadow canary config); 6) PM acceptance criteria and handoff checklist for Eng/Legal/Support.

Why this is different: Instead of a generic priority score we produce a multi-axis compatibility matrix (operational cost, license/regulatory risk, QA coverage gap, migration effort). That enables deterministic SLA negotiation and reduces repeated manual triage for enterprise customers.

Out of scope: Full UI implementation in Console (this ticket covers schema, backend routing rules, and the eval templates). Console UX work will be a follow-up (PM-142010).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Intake schema defined and stored in Confluence + intake form JSON schema added to repo. 2) Compatibility checker prototype runs against 5 representative model artifacts and produces a numeric score + human-readable warnings. 3) Eval gate templates documented with example prompts and metrics. 4) Regulatory lane flow documented with required fields and a sample legal checklist. 5) Handoff doc for Eng/Legal/Support with runbook for safe-pin and rollback. 6) Demo of routing decisions in the staging triage service during RFC review.
